methodologyNotes: Pricing fetched directly from each vendor's official pricing page or Shopify App Store listing using WebFetch. Where the official page returned 403/JS-only/no prices, reputable third-party comparison sources (GetApp, Shopify App Store) were used and noted in provenance. accessedAt set to 2026-06-14 per dataset convention. monthlyUsd for annual-only plans is the annualized monthly rate; month-to-month rates noted where available. Open Loyalty publishes no self-serve prices (custom quote only based on monthly active members). Yotpo Loyalty official pricing page is JS-gated/returns no prices; GetApp used as primary source with note. LoyalZoo official site shows $77/mo for Grow plan; GetApp shows outdated $47/mo — official site used. Stamped.io official pricing page (website.stamped.io) returned 403; GetApp confirms starting at $19/mo but full tier data unavailable — Stamped included as quote-only. Talon.One: all plans custom/quote. ReferralHero annual discount: 3 months free (25% off effective annual rate).
